elements.author: micaelgomestavares
elements.description: Dark rounded sky-blue login form that changes colour on hover.
elements.howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #ffffff to #252727, border becomes 1px solid #2d79f3. On focus, the outline is removed, border becomes 1.5px solid #2d79f3.

elements.name: Tiny Moose 42
elements.author: ahmed_8975
elements.description: Glass neon gradient lime checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
elements.howItWorks:
On hover, border-color becomes #c8f060, transform becomes scale(1.06), text color changes from #ffffff to #ffffff. Clicking it toggles it: background changes from #ffffff to linear-gradient(135deg, #c8f060, #60f0b8), border-color becomes transparent, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 3px #c8f060,
    0 4px 14px #c8f060.

elements.name: Brown Turtle 51
elements.author: vinodjangid07
elements.description: Gradient rounded indigo button that responds while pressed down.
elements.howItWorks: While pressed, transform becomes translate(2px ,0px), box-shadow becomes 0px 1px 0px #8b71ff.

elements.name: Hard Starfish 64
elements.author: Mohammad-Rahme-576
elements.description: Glass neon gradient pill blue tooltip that glows and scales up on hover.
elements.howItWorks:
On hover, opacity becomes 1, transform becomes scale(1), background changes from #2a2a2a to linear-gradient(135deg, #a777e3, #6e8efb). On focus, the outline is removed, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 3px #6e8efb,
    0 8px 15px #000000, box-shadow becomes 0 8px 15px #000000.
